items.title: Bucky Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: Al stayed in New York and hooked up with Donny — I can’t think of his last name off hand — but he became a big publisher.

ctx.x: You just walked to all these gigs.

Yeah. I could walk and everything. And when Kate Smith’s show ended that season I went to — I joined the group as a regular. And Al stayed in New York and hooked up with Donny — I can’t think of his last name off hand — but he became a big publisher.
